title: Dry-run the CI retry sweep locally and by manual dispatch
answers: how do I test the retry script without rerunning CI
run retry.sh dry run for a commit
manually trigger the CI retry workflow safely
check which failed runs would be retried
body:
Run the script directly as `.github/workflows/retry.sh --dry-run OWNER/REPO FULL_SHA`. `--dry-run` must be the first argument; the repo must be `owner/name` and the SHA a 40-hex commit. `MAX_RETRIES` (default 3 in the workflow) must be a non-negative integer. Use `--help` or `-h` alone to print usage.
The Retry workflow is started with workflow_dispatch; its `dry_run` input defaults to true, so a manual run only prints the "Would rerun" lines. Untick it to submit real reruns. The scheduled run is always real.
The script is downloaded at the workflow's GITHUB_SHA, so edits to retry.sh only affect scheduled runs after they are merged to the default branch.
applies: Local and manual validation of the Retry workflow in this repository; the scheduled run has no dry-run.
says: Preview which failed automated test runs would be restarted without actually launching them.
Safely test the automated rerun tool before triggering real build jobs in CI.
Inspect candidate failed workflows for a specific commit without triggering unexpected test executions.
How do I manually run the retry sweep to simulate reruns using default settings?
Check which broken builds qualify for automatic restarts before submitting genuine rerun requests.
search: To dry-run CI retries locally, execute `.github/workflows/retry.sh --dry-run OWNER/REPO FULL_SHA` where `--dry-run` is the first argument, the repository is formatted as owner/name, the commit is a 40-hex SHA, and `MAX_RETRIES` is a non-negative integer (default 3). For manual CI execution via workflow_dispatch in .github/workflows/retry.yml, the `dry_run` input defaults to true to print 'Would rerun' lines, requiring unticking to trigger real reruns. Scheduled runs are always real without dry-run support, and retry.sh changes only affect scheduled workflows once merged into the default branch because the workflow downloads the script at GITHUB_SHA.
